# Refactor
## When to use
Structural improvement only.
## Required context
Callers and current behavior.
## Preconditions
Keep behavior changes separate.
## Procedure
Pin behavior with characterization tests, change one boundary at a time,
and activate `refactoring` for detailed safeguards.
## Tools
Focused checks and diff.
## Rules
Preserve public contracts.
## Verification
Check callers and observable effects.
## Evidence
Characterization results.
## Completion criteria
Structure changed without observed drift.
## Failure modes
Behavior differs: investigate before proceeding.
## References
[Refactor guidance](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. Always run it from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
